```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r load-data}
years <- seq(2020, 2050, 5)
lab_a <- paste(params$a_label, params$a_scen)
lab_b <- paste(params$b_label, params$b_scen)

to_long <- function(df, label) {
  df %>%
    select(variable = Variable, unit = Unit, any_of(as.character(years))) %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(as.character(years)), as.numeric)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(variable, unit), names_to = "year", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(year = as.numeric(year), source = label) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))
}

# A: the KMIP2025 submission workbook (xlsx, sheet "data"; scenario names may
# have trailing spaces) or a step4 output csv (variables_after_unit_conversion.csv)
# File name may be stored in NFD form (Korean): match it NFC-normalized
a_file <- params$a_file
if (!file.exists(a_file)) {
  cand <- list.files(dirname(a_file), full.names = TRUE)
  a_file <- cand[stringi::stri_trans_nfc(basename(cand)) == stringi::stri_trans_nfc(basename(a_file))][1]
}
a_is_step4 <- grepl("\\.csv$", a_file)
a_raw <- if (a_is_step4) {
  read_csv(a_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% filter(Scenario == params$a_scen)
} else {
  read_excel(a_file, sheet = "data") %>%
    filter(Model == params$a_model, str_trim(Scenario) == params$a_scen)
}
# B: kaist9 step4 output
b_raw <- read_csv(file.path(params$b_dir, "variables_after_unit_conversion.csv"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(Scenario == params$b_scen)
stopifnot(nrow(a_raw) > 0, nrow(b_raw) > 0)

combined_data <- bind_rows(to_long(a_raw, lab_a), to_long(b_raw, lab_b)) %>%
  mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c(lab_a, lab_b)))

# Units: take A's unit, B's when A has none
unit_of <- combined_data %>% distinct(variable, unit) %>% filter(!is.na(unit)) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>% summarise(unit = first(unit))

year_labels <- function(x) ifelse(x == 2020, "2020/21", as.character(x))
```

This report compares two scenarios variable by variable:

- **A** = `r lab_a`: `r if (a_is_step4) "KMIP2025 database (GCAM-KAIST7) run through this pipeline (step4 output)" else paste0("KMIP2025 submission (GCAM-KAIST7, model ", params$a_model, "), from the submission workbook")`.
- **B** = `r lab_b`: GCAM-KAIST 9.1 (kaist9) step4 output (`variables_after_unit_conversion.csv`).

Both use the KMIP template variable names and units. Notes:

- kaist9 has no 2020 period; its 2021 values sit in the 2020 column. The year axis shows this as "2020/21".
- Bunker rule (international aviation/shipping removed): kaist9 uses domestic shares 0.099/0.039 (GIR 2023); the KMIP2025 submission used 0.093/0.032.
- Sign convention: the KMIP2025 workbook reports CCS as negative numbers, step4 outputs as positive. The Carbon Sequestration sections show all captured amounts as positive.
- The sub-sector sections (industry sub-sectors, transport modes, residential/commercial) are mostly empty in the submission workbook; use a step4 csv of the KMIP2025 database as A to fill them.
- Totals in the tables are the sum of the plotted variables. Where the template total variable (e.g. Secondary Energy|Hydrogen) differs from that sum, the per-section CSV also has the reported totals (A_reported, B_reported).
- Capacity Additions: the KMIP2025 workbook has zeros, and the kaist9 values look wrong (e.g. Wind Offshore over 2,000 GW in 2050); do not use that section yet.
- Each section: stacked bars (A left, B right, same y scale), a totals table (Diff = B - A), and a variable table for 2030 and 2050. Variables that are zero or missing in both scenarios are dropped from the legend.

```{r functions}
# d3 category20 colors (same look as compare_manual_report.qmd)
pal20 <- c("#1F77B4", "#AEC7E8", "#FF7F0E", "#FFBB78", "#2CA02C", "#98DF8A", "#D62728",
           "#FF9896", "#9467BD", "#C5B0D5", "#8C564B", "#C49C94", "#E377C2", "#F7B6D2",
           "#7F7F7F", "#C7C7C7", "#BCBD22", "#DBDB8D", "#17BECF", "#9EDAE5")

# Shortest legend label: drop the prefix shared by all variables
short_names <- function(v) {
  if (length(v) == 1) return(v)
  if (any(str_detect(v, "^Emissions\\|"))) return(str_remove(v, "^Emissions\\|[^|]+\\|(Energy\\|)?"))
  parts <- str_split(v, fixed("|"))
  n <- 0
  while (n < min(lengths(parts)) - 1 &&
         length(unique(map_chr(parts, ~ .x[n + 1]))) == 1) n <- n + 1
  map_chr(parts, ~ paste(.x[(n + 1):length(.x)], collapse = "|"))
}

section_data <- function(sec) {
  all_vars <- c(sec$pos, sec$pos2, sec$neg)
  d <- combined_data %>%
    filter(variable %in% all_vars) %>%
    select(-unit) %>%
    complete(variable, source, year = years, fill = list(value = 0)) %>%
    mutate(value = if_else(variable %in% sec$neg, -abs(value), value),
           value = if (isTRUE(sec$abs_all)) abs(value) else value)
  keep <- d %>% group_by(variable) %>% summarise(nz = any(abs(value) > 1e-9)) %>%
    filter(nz) %>% pull(variable)
  d %>% filter(variable %in% keep) %>%
    mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = intersect(all_vars, keep)))
}

section_unit <- function(sec) {
  u <- unit_of %>% filter(variable %in% c(sec$pos, sec$pos2, sec$neg)) %>% pull(unit) %>% unique()
  if (length(u) == 0) "" else u[1]
}

make_plot <- function(d, unit) {
  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "No data", size = 8) + theme_void())
  }
  vars <- levels(d$variable)
  cols <- if (length(vars) <= 20) pal20[seq_along(vars)] else colorRampPalette(pal20)(length(vars))
  ggplot(d, aes(x = year, y = value, fill = variable)) +
    geom_col(width = 4, position = "stack") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ source, ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(cols, vars), labels = short_names(vars), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = years, labels = year_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = unit) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
          strip.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.9, "cm"),
          legend.position = "right")
}

reported_total <- function(sec) {
  if (is.null(sec$total)) return(NULL)
  combined_data %>% filter(variable == sec$total) %>%
    mutate(source = if_else(source == lab_a, "A_reported", "B_reported")) %>%
    select(year, source, value) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = value)
}

totals_table <- function(d) {
  d %>% group_by(source, year) %>% summarise(total = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = total) %>%
    rename(A = all_of(lab_a), B = all_of(lab_b)) %>%
    mutate(Diff = B - A, `Diff (%)` = if_else(abs(A) > 1e-9, 100 * Diff / A, NA_real_))
}

detail_table <- function(d, yr) {
  d %>% filter(year == yr) %>%
    mutate(variable = as.character(variable), source = if_else(source == lab_a, "A", "B")) %>%
    select(variable, source, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = value) %>%
    select(variable, A, B) %>%
    mutate(Diff = B - A, `Diff (%)` = if_else(abs(A) > 1e-9, 100 * Diff / A, NA_real_))
}

fmt <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ",")
```

```{r run-sections, results='asis', fig.width=16, fig.height=9}
if (params$save_png) dir.create(params$out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
all_detail <- list()

for (sec in sections) {
  d <- section_data(sec)
  unit <- section_unit(sec)
  p <- make_plot(d, unit)

  cat("\n\n```{=latex}\n\\newpage\n```\n\n")
  cat("## ", gsub("|", "\\|", sec$title, fixed = TRUE), "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
  if (nrow(d) == 0) next
  zero_src <- d %>% group_by(source) %>% summarise(nz = any(abs(value) > 1e-9), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(!nz) %>% pull(source)
  if (length(zero_src) > 0)
    cat("All values are zero or missing in ", paste(as.character(zero_src), collapse = ", "), ".\n\n", sep = "")

  tot <- totals_table(d)
  if (params$save_png) {
    ggsave(file.path(params$out_dir, paste0(sec$slug, ".png")), p,
           width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 100, bg = "white")
    rep_tot <- reported_total(sec)
    tot_csv <- if (is.null(rep_tot)) tot else left_join(tot, rep_tot, by = "year")
    write_csv(tot_csv %>% mutate(unit = unit) %>%
                rename(!!paste0("A_", params$a_scen) := A, !!paste0("B_", params$b_scen) := B),
              file.path(params$out_dir, paste0(sec$slug, "_totals.csv")))
  }

  tot_show <- tot %>% mutate(year = year_labels(year), across(c(A, B, Diff, `Diff (%)`), fmt))
  cat(knitr::kable(tot_show, col.names = c("Year", lab_a, lab_b, "Diff (B-A)", "Diff (%)"),
                   align = "lrrrr", caption = paste0("Total by year (", unit, ")")), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")

  for (yr in c(2030, 2050)) {
    det <- detail_table(d, yr)
    all_detail[[paste(sec$slug, yr)]] <- det %>% mutate(section = sec$title, year = yr, unit = unit)
    det_show <- det %>% filter(abs(Diff) > 1e-6) %>%
      mutate(variable = short_names(variable), across(c(A, B, Diff, `Diff (%)`), fmt))
    if (nrow(det_show) == 0) next
    cat(knitr::kable(det_show, col.names = c("Variable", "A", "B", "Diff (B-A)", "Diff (%)"),
                     align = "lrrrr", caption = paste0(yr, " by variable (", unit, ")")), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}

if (params$save_png) {
  write_csv(bind_rows(all_detail) %>% relocate(section, year, unit),
            file.path(params$out_dir, "all_sections_by_variable_2030_2050.csv"))
}
```

## Template variables with values in only one scenario

```{r only-one}
has_val <- combined_data %>% group_by(variable, source) %>%
  summarise(nz = any(abs(value) > 1e-9), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = nz, values_fill = FALSE)
only <- has_val %>% filter(.data[[lab_a]] != .data[[lab_b]]) %>%
  mutate(`Has values in` = if_else(.data[[lab_a]], lab_a, lab_b)) %>%
  select(Variable = variable, `Has values in`) %>% arrange(`Has values in`, Variable)
knitr::kable(only)
```
